sourceSentences: Jax dashes to the target unit's location.
Jax can cast any of his abilities during the dash.
Leap Strike cannot be cast on structures.
Spell shield will block the damage, including when Empower.
Jax empowers his next basic attack or Leap Strike against an enemy within 10 seconds to deal additional magic damage
If Empower is used on a basic attack, it will gain range and have an uncancellable windup.
Empower resets Jax's basic attack timer.
a defensive stance that causes him to dodge all incoming non-turret basic attacks and take 25% reduced damage from all area of effect abilities sourced from champions.
Counter Strike will also dodge abilities that can trigger on-hit effects (Parrrley, Mystic Shot) which will count towards Counter Strike's increased damage.
Counter Strike can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
At 2 stacks, his next basic attack on-hit is empowered to have an uncancellable windup and consume all stacks to deal additional magic damage
While Grandmaster-at-Arms is active, the empowered attack triggers at 1 stack instead.
Jax can move during Grandmaster-at-Arms' cast time.

Jax's basic attacks generate a stack of Relentless Assault on-attack for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 8 times. Stacks expire one by one every 0.25 seconds when the duration ends.
